Project Title Draft Environmental Statement on Implementation of Executive Order 11644Use of Off-Road Vehicles on the Public Lands

July 6, 1972
Return to Budget Division, Dept. of Administration lst Floor, Statehouse, Topeka, Kansas 66612
The enclosed proposal has been submitted to the Budget Division under its clearinghouse responsibilities described in Bureau of the Budget Circular A-95. Your review of this proposal as it affects the interest of the state will be appreciated. Your appropriate comments concerning the proposal should be submitted to the Budget Division no later than the date specified above.
Comments filed on a proposal may include: (1) the extent to which the project is consistent with or contributes to the fulfillment of comprehensive planning within the state; (2) how the proposal relates to state objectives; and (3) the effect of the proposal on your agency's activities.
COMMENTS:
Executive Order 11644, though confined to regulation of off-road vehicles
on certain Department of the Interior and Department of Agriculture lands,
is compatible with objectives, activities and comprehensive planning
related to land management by the Kansas Forestry, Fish and Game Commission.
This Order addresses itself to problems common to Federal and State juris-
dictions. The Kansas Forestry, Fish and Game Commission has recognized
these problems at the state level and proposes to alter its regulations
to effect similar controls over its lands. Federal action will serve to
support the imposition, acceptance and control of off-road vehicles on
state jurisdictions
